observations: Photo 0 and photo 1: a black DSLR body with 'Nikon' on the prism and 'D3300' on the front badge, body cap fitted, no lens mounted.
Beside it a Nikon DX zoom lens marked VR with focal markings 18 to 55 and a front cap on.
Both sit on a retail box printed 'D3300 18-55 VR II Kit, AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II, Black'.
Background is a camera shop shelf with flashes and selfie sticks; watermark 'Posted on Jiji Photoplug Integrated'.
No screen, battery, charger, strap or menu screenshot is shown; the outside of the body and lens looks clean with no visible damage.
Both photos are near identical angles of the same set.

identity.model: D3300 with AF-S DX 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II kit lens

claims.claim: 24.2 MP DX sensor, 5 fps, 11 AF points with 3D tracking
claims.evidence: Body reads D3300 in photos 0 and 1, which matches these published specs.
No shutter count screenshot from a test photo's metadata.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Lens shown capped; no photo through the glass against light.
Neither battery nor charger appears in any photo.
Repair history cannot be seen in photos.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on, shoot or focus correctly.
risks.proof: Clip of the camera powering on, taking a shot with the lens mounted, and the shot playing back on the screen.
Screenshot of a shutter count reading from a fresh test photo, with the camera serial visible.

risks.risk: Fungus, haze or scratches in the lens, or autofocus and VR faults.
risks.proof: Photo through the uncapped lens held against a light, plus a clip of it focusing.
risks.if_unproven: as lens with fungus or faults

risks.risk: Battery or charger missing or non original.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger with labels readable.
risks.if_unproven: as body and lens only, no battery or charger

risks.risk: Shop display photos may not be the exact unit sold; LCD and sensor condition unseen.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear screen showing a live image and the serial plate under the body, with a handwritten code in shot.
risks.if_unproven: as the worst condition consistent with the photos

proof_requests: Clip powering on, shooting and playing back an image with the lens mounted
Shutter count screenshot from a fresh test photo
Photo through the uncapped lens against a light
Photo of the rear screen and the serial plate under the body with a handwritten code
response.reason: The brand and model are readable on the body, lens and box, so it can be priced as a Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II kit at its worst case, untested with no battery or charger. Proof of function, shutter count and accessories would raise it.
